title: AI assistant
urlHint: HTTPS; include /v1 or /v1beta when required, not the full chat endpoint
keySaved: Key for this service is securely saved; leave blank to keep it
keyHint: Stored only in the device secure vault
modelHint: Models come from this service. Availability does not guarantee tool support; choose another if chat fails.
privacy: Chat and requested repository code, including private repositories, are sent to your configured AI service. Use a trusted service. GitHub tokens stay on the device for the signed-in account’s GitHub requests. Chat and audit history are encrypted locally.
welcome: Open from a repository or say “switch to owner/repo”. Read code, propose changes, manage Issues / PRs and run builds. Writes always show a preview.
buildReady: Build finished; open AI chat to download artifacts
buildFailed: Build did not succeed; check Actions
starsPartial: Loaded the first 2,000 stars; search covers these repositories
watchScope: Checks default-branch commits and new Releases about every 5 minutes while running, and on resume. No real-time alerts when closed or terminated.
statsScope: Scope: your commits searchable by the current account, grouped by commit date. Line changes are measured for up to 100 commits. This is not the contribution calendar or net repository size; unindexed commits are excluded.
statsPartial: Results include sampling or failed requests; line counts cover only successfully measured commits
cannotRollback: This operation cannot be rolled back automatically
disabled: Enable the assistant in AI settings
fileTooLarge: File or proposal is too large
headChanged: Remote content changed; refused to overwrite. Read and review again
invalidEndpoint: Configure a valid HTTPS API base URL
invalidProposal: AI proposal is incomplete or invalid
invalidRepo: Select a valid owner/repo repository first
keyRequired: Configure an API key for this service
requestFailed: Request failed; check network, key, permissions and model tool support
responseTruncated: Model output truncated; proposal not executed. Reduce the task
secretFile: Credential files cannot be read or changed through AI
toolLimit: Tool limit reached; continue with a smaller task
treeTruncated: Repository tree incomplete; no commit made
unsupportedFile: Symlinks, submodules and binary files are unsupported
markAllReadSubmitted: Request submitted. Refreshing; GitHub may process it in the background.
